# Keplar Flow Limited

🌌 Pioneering Industry 5.0 for Sustainable Decent Work and Value Creation.

## ✨ What We're About

- 🔍 Empowering organizations and individuals with Industry 5.0 technologies
- 🧩 Building high-value networks of certified professionals and businesses
- 🌱 Promoting sustainable decent work initiatives through AI-driven automation
- 🔄 Evolving from automation to human-centric, resilient systems with digital cognitive clones

## 🚀 Our Work

Keplar Flow blends research, design, and engineering to create tech-scaled businesses. We explore new ways of combining 🧪 science, 📊 data, and 💙 empathy to deliver value through:

- **Studio-Hub**: Our physical office space for digital transformation, decent work promotion, and Industry 5.0 hybrid implementations across sectors (Media, Real Estate, Consultancy, Agriculture, IT Services).
- **Liluts**: Lightweight, useful tools using Liquid AI models for community-driven innovation.
- **Decent Work Initiatives**: Partner networks for fair labor, skill development, and mutual value creation.
- **Agentic AI Systems**: From simple automation to purposeful, cognitive agents that enhance human decision-making.

## 🌍 Why

Because the right technology at the right time can transform industries, empower communities, and build a resilient future. We aim to "empower everyone and every organisation in the world to do more" by integrating efficiency with human values.

## Key Initiatives

- [Studio-Hub](https://github.com/Keplar-Flow-ltd/studio-hub) - Digital transformation hub operations.
- [Liluts-Flightly](https://github.com/Keplar-Flow-ltd/liluts-flightly) - Flight booking assistant (renamed from liluts-flight-assistant).
- [LiquidAI SLM Cookbook](https://github.com/Keplar-Flow-ltd/liquidaislmcookbook) - Examples and tools for Liquid AI models.
- [Studio-Hub Agents](https://github.com/Keplar-Flow-ltd/studio-hub-agents) - Specialized AI agents for operations.
